security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://tile.openstreetmap.org https://server.arcgisonline.com; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://photon.komoot.io

bundle.shortDescription: Offline photo time & location metadata editor
bundle.longDescription: Pick photos from local storage and edit their capture time, date and GPS location interactively on a map and on a day timeline. Photos never leave the computer; only map tiles and place searches use the network.
